name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Tanner and Bridgegate, one goes with Aldric and the other with Edmund.

Rowan goes with at least one of Tanner or Riverside.
Aldric goes with Potter if and only if Beatrix belongs to the Hill Ward.
